# Before renaming `POST /orders`

`POST /orders` answers to more than one thing.

Ask the person which one they mean, then use this prompt again with its id:

- `entry:gateway:http:POST:/orders` — POST /orders, entry in gateway at `src/orders/gateway.controller.ts:11`: `who_calls({symbol: "entry:gateway:http:POST:/orders"})`
- `entry:orders:http:POST:/orders` — POST /orders, entry in orders at `src/orders/orders.controller.ts:23`: `who_calls({symbol: "entry:orders:http:POST:/orders"})`
